== Summary ==
The Players Committee's Remaster sheet <code>VirtualCards9.pdf</code> for [[Virtual Set 9: Sanctuary Moon]] (official text as of 4 December 2006, with errata to card 10 on 17 September 2007; PDF made 13 September 2007). It has a cover, the set symbol and the Remaster slips. It is a later version than [[:File:Original Virtual Set 9 card slips.pdf]], which is the first sheet of the set with different text.

* '''Date:''' 13 September 2007 (PDF creation date)
* '''Pages:''' 4

== Source ==
[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards9.pdf VirtualCards9.pdf], Star Wars CCG Players Committee, res.starwarsccg.org. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008195543/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards9.pdf Internet Archive]. The archived copy is byte-identical to this file (the SHA-1 of the archived payload matches).
